Drug Name: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)
Indication: Prevention of COVID-19
Dose: 100 mcg / 0.5 mL
Route: Intramuscular
Dose Number: Dose 1
Date of Administration: 13 June 2026
3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 72-year-old male received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 23 April 2026. Approximately 3 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Facial Palsy. The patient sought medical attention and was managed outpatient. The outcome was recovering. The reporter considers the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
